desc: I-Power Solutions India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 28/08/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve fix Day, Date, Time and Venue for the ensuing Annual General Meeting (AGM) for the financial year 2025-26, Notice of ensuing AGM, Board's Report and Secretarial Audit Report for the financial year 2025-26 and others.
